title: Error dialog
description: A screenshot of a system or application error dialog on a desktop (Windows or macOS look, chosen by variant).

appName.description: Application that raised the dialog (window title on Windows, menu-bar app on macOS). Generic names only, no real product brands.

message.description: Main error text exactly as the system shows it. Newlines are kept.
examples: Error 404: Backup Tape Library Not Mounted. Restoration Failed. Please insert Tape Set #44-B manually.

errorCode.description: Code or hex value shown under the message.

details.description: Technical details block (monospace), e.g. job name, device, path.

buttons.description: Button labels in on-screen order. The first is the default (highlighted) button on Windows; the last on macOS.

clock.description: Time on the taskbar / menu-bar clock.

hostLabel.description: Machine label in the corner (remote-desktop style), e.g. server name.
